crew.overview: Two highly trained operatives grow close from a distance after being sent to guard opposite sides of a mysterious gorge. When an evil below emerges, they must work together to survive what lies within.
crew.title: The Gorge

details.biography:
Chandra started working in the industry as a child actress having attended Sylvia Young Theatre School.

After more than twenty years, she decided to move into the world of casting.

She initially started out in theatre but has moved across to screen also and works across both fields with success.
details.name: Chandra Ruegg
